description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Use when an agent needs a price/volume chart or back-data for a small-cap or meme token on Base, BNB Chain or pump.fun. ~15-min snapshots kept 30 days with high/low/change summary. Returns JSON about-15-minute price and volume snapshots (kept 30 days) with a high, low, and change summary.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of the token. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: bsc. Send it with token. The schema does not mark it required. Allowed values: base, bsc, solana.

hours.description: How many hours of snapshots. Format: a positive number, within the 30 days the tool keeps. Example: 24. Omit for the server's current span.

token.description: Token to chart. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters on Base or BNB Chain, or a Solana mint. Example: 0x97d62f3d00d3134c0f8f3e73775c580aa3707777. Required.

name: meme_history
title: Small/meme token price + volume history ($0.01)
